role_dispositions.inventory: Contract offered/accepted/ready/paid/withdrawn+optional prior acceptance; MissionBinding optional site/group, HostileResolution captured subject+CustodyVersion; flat status/options input; commitment reserved/effective vs resolved/reason; formal approval/dowry vs informal secrecy; active/exposed/ended courtship; active/widowed/ended marriage; active/born/ended pregnancy; closed-parser error text; existing fixtures.
role_dispositions.disposition: Parsed payload states improve flattened rows. Unaccepted withdrawn contract legitimately has no acceptance; committed captured result permits absent mission binding (fixture448-456), while captured requires subject+version and killed subject needs no version. CustodyVersion0 explicitly valid (508-517), no invented nonzero bound. Raw party/hostile/subject/character IDs remain semantically different. Courtship route and lifecycle are independent axes; formal approved father/dowry differs from informal secrecy, no force one route from ended status. Commitment effective is scheduled ceremony time, not universal historical start: cancellation need not wait until it. CommitmentState::Cancelled publicly accepts all CommitmentTerminalReason values although parser narrows to five cancellation reasons; payload owner can express that subset. Public Paid/other states similarly bypass chronology parser, a qualified static API shape issue, not an actual malformed retained row. Marriage widowed versus ended preserves cause; pregnancy birth requires child identity.
role_dispositions.remedy: Retain payload state enums and vocabulary at flat storage boundary. Use canonical party/subject/character/group IDs and narrowed cancellation payload/private admitted terminal states; avoid a generic terminal bool/reason string. Keep route separate from status and optional mission binding when supported. Derive fixed terminal reasons from parsed variants instead of redundantly retaining authoritative status+reason internally.

role_dispositions.inventory: Bounded StrategicMinuteOfDay vs absolute StrategicMinute and elapsed/movement minutes; daily walking budget/day-night policy; real signed timestamps/microsecond durations vs official strategic clock; TravelFatigueInputs/ItineraryMember energy-like reservoir/capacity; camp and walking segment records, member-indexed final/peak fatigue; lunar cyclic phase/illumination; daily training rate and elapsed duration; normalized limb health/convalescence duration; existing fixtures.
role_dispositions.disposition: Existing minute-of-day owner0..<1440 differs from schedule end1440 sentinel (046); reuse with explicit end-of-day policy rather than conflate. Elapsed versus movement time deliberately differs (fixture674-697:12h movement28h elapsed), camp movement0 and walking movement==duration; public tag-plus-record can express inconsistent combinations, actual producer coherent. Forecast per-member final/maximum Vecs rely on same bounded input order; no actual reordered recipient proved. Fatigue ratios may exceed1 (exhausted9000/cap6000 fixture), so not UnitInterval or wheel display cut-off; capacity requires positive numeric role but raw input sanitization masks bad values. Calories_used and fatigue reservoir naming/units need canonical association; no second hidden impairment or speed penalty inferred: actual itinerary uses configured daily walking window and fixed movement duration, travel-leg threshold chooses stop duration, not speed factor. Lunar phase wraps cyclically, not an ordinary closed interpolation endpoint; illumination is bounded fraction. Public convalescence health raw finite/0..1 versus duration u64MAX sentinel for unreachable recovery are separate; do not force all raw health/limits through one numeric type. Real epoch timestamp, elapsed real micros and strategic minute distinct even when integers.
role_dispositions.remedy: Carry typed elapsed/movement/day-budget/time-of-day and positive capacity/nonnegative accumulated-fatigue quantities; use payload-owned Camp/Walking segments and member-associated fatigue result records when retained across APIs. Keep cyclic phase separate from fraction, represent convalescence finite duration vs unbounded outcome explicitly rather than generic u64MAX where consumed. Preserve native real-clock conversion at timestamp adapter and intended saturation. No arbitrary tightened physiology/time bounds, no prescriptive travel-speed penalty conclusion.
